## Closes (required)

<!-- Replace NNN with the implementation issue number. Example: Closes #325 -->

Closes #

> **Required on every PR.** `Closes #NNN` tells GitHub to **auto-close the linked issue** when this PR merges to `develop`. Without it, issues stay open after merge and project board cards drift (TD-020). PR title must also use the `[#NNN]` prefix so **Project Board Sync** can move the card to **In Review** on open and **Done** on merge.
